label: banned three major media outlets (CNN, Politico, MS Now) from White House grounds and confiscated press credentials
detail: President Trump denied White House access to journalists from CNN, Politico, and MS Now on Saturday morning, confiscating their press credentials. Trump announced the ban via Truth Social on Friday, stating he was banning the organizations because of their 'constant reporting of fake news,' and later said 'I don't have to let them into the people's house.'
source_title: Trump escalates media fight after week of setbacks

label: conducted drone attack on Moscow region killing at least two people
detail: Ukraine launched a large-scale drone attack on Moscow and the Moscow region, killing at least two people and damaging a major oil refinery. President Zelenskyy praised the strikes, stating they targeted key Russian oil industry and logistics facilities. Russian authorities reported intercepting over 1,600 drones, with 450 heading for the capital.
source_title: Two killed in Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow, says Russia

label: pushed back on US warnings over rapid AI development, rejecting calls for slowdown as bid to lock in US advantage
detail: China's foreign ministry responded to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for 'worldwide pacing of the frontier' AI development by saying 'fearmongering, confrontation and vicious competition will only disrupt the process of global AI governance.' Analysts noted China views such slowdown calls as an attempt to lock in US technological advantage and will not jeopardize progress in closing the gap with US frontier models, as AI is considered a 'core sovereignty capability.'
source_title: Why China is pushing back on US warnings over rapid AI development

label: targeted Moscow with hundreds of drones on final day of Russian parliamentary election
detail: Ukraine conducted a large-scale drone attack on Moscow and the surrounding region, involving hundreds of drones. The attack killed at least three people and damaged a Moscow oil refinery. Ukraine's President Zelenskyy confirmed the use of domestically produced Flamingo cruise missiles and other weapons in the strike.
source_title: Hundreds of drones target Moscow on last day of voting in Russia’s parliamentary election

label: warns that Trump's war with Iran will complicate next month's budget
detail: UK minister Bridget Phillipson stated that next month's budget will be made more difficult by Donald Trump's military campaign against Iran, which has disrupted global oil supplies and caused inflationary pressures that will affect the chancellor's budget planning.
source_title: UK minister warns of impact of Trump’s Iran war on next month’s budget

label: called for Europe to take a more sensible view of Trump's administration and said he wants to bring Trump's ICE adviser to the UK to help secure borders
detail: Nigel Farage, Reform UK leader, speaking at a US event, said he wants to 'hijack' Tom Homan, Trump's ICE adviser, and bring him to the UK to help secure UK borders. Farage also called for Europe to take a 'more sensible view' of the Trump administration rather than seeing it as 'villainous'.
source_title: Farage says he wants to ‘hijack’ Trump’s ICE czar to help secure UK border

label: reached a security deal on Greenland
detail: The US and Denmark announced a deal on Greenland's security, resolving a diplomatic dispute. Denmark maintains sovereignty while the US develops a significant military presence on the island and bans adversaries from building bases there.
source_title: US and Denmark reach Greenland security deal

label: called state election results a 'disaster' for his party but vowed to stay on as chancellor
detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz declared the results of state elections in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Berlin a 'disaster' for his CDU party, with exit polls showing the AfD winning the most votes in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and Die Linke ahead in Berlin. Despite mounting pressure and speculation about his replacement, Merz vowed to remain as chancellor and continue pursuing economic, tax, and welfare reforms.
source_title: German Chancellor Merz calls state election a 'disaster' for his party but vows to stay on

label: announced triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers
detail: US President Donald Trump said his proposed triumphal arch in Washington DC will double as a military complex to store and deploy drones and snipers, stating he is updating plans at the request of the US military for national security purposes.
source_title: Trump says triumphal arch will be military complex with drones and snipers

label: imposed 50 percent tariff on Canadian dairy products and other goods
detail: US President Donald Trump imposed a 50 percent tariff on $20 billion in Canadian goods, including dairy products, which came into effect on August 22, 2026. The tariffs have caused Canadian dairy exports to the US to stall, impacting dairy farmers and processors who rely on cross-border sales.
source_title: Trump tariffs hit Canada’s dairy farmers as US sales stall

label: promised to ban burqas and niqabs in schools and limit foreign students in classes
detail: Italy's Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced proposed changes including banning burqas and niqabs in schools, limiting the number of foreign students in classes, and making Italian language lessons compulsory for parents of foreign students with integration difficulties. The proposals were outlined at a gathering of her Brothers of Italy party's youth wing and would require parliamentary approval within 60 days to become law.
source_title: Meloni promises to ban burqas, niqabs in Italy’s schools

label: president pledged to mobilize state resources to fight forest fire threatening Villa de Leyva
detail: Colombian President Abelardo de la Espriella posted on X that Villa de Leyva is not alone, pledging to mobilise all state resources to fight a massive wildfire in central Colombia's Boyaca department that has consumed 40 hectares of native forest and threatens the popular tourist town.
source_title: Central Colombia forest fire threatens tourist town of Villa de Leyva

label: announced that planned triumphal arch in Washington DC will also function as military complex for drones and equipment
detail: Donald Trump posted on social media that a planned triumphal arch near iconic Washington, DC landmarks will serve as a military complex to house, store, and deploy drones, snipers, and ammunition, saying the changes were made at the military's request for national security purposes.
source_title: Trump says monumental arch in Washington, DC will also be military complex

label: Netanyahu tours tunnels beneath Al-Aqsa Mosque compound
detail: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu posted a video of himself and his wife walking through tunnels beneath occupied East Jerusalem's Old City and the Al-Aqsa Mosque compound, before attending Selichot prayers at the Western Wall ahead of Yom Kippur.
source_title: Netanyahu tours tunnels underneath Al-Aqsa Mosque compound

label: arrested Aleema Khan, sister of former PM Imran Khan, ahead of planned PTI protest march
detail: Pakistan's police arrested Aleema Khan, sister of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan, from her house in Lahore on September 20, 2026. The arrest came a week before a planned September 27 protest march by Khan's PTI party demanding his release. Khan was detained under the Maintenance of Public Order law for 30 days.
source_title: Former Pakistan PM Imran Khan’s sister arrested before planned PTI march

label: prime minister warned of potential Russian attack on NATO territory in coming months
detail: Poland's Prime Minister Donald Tusk told parliament that intelligence assessments suggested Russia might launch an attack with drones or missiles on NATO territory in the coming months, as part of efforts to prove that 'article 5 is more theoretical than practical'.
source_title: European spy chiefs warn Moscow is planning more decisive action against Nato

label: warned that advisers are compromising his legacy on immigration enforcement
detail: María Elvira Salazar, a Republican congresswoman from Florida, criticized President Trump's immigration enforcement policies in a CBS News interview, warning that some of his advisers were 'not presenting the whole picture' and urging him not to 'squander' his relationship with Hispanic voters. She pointed out that law-abiding undocumented immigrants were being caught up in aggressive federal deportation sweeps.
source_title: House Republican doubles down on jab at Trump’s immigration enforcement

label: claimed a triumphal arch will serve as a military complex for weapons storage
detail: Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that his planned 250ft triumphal arch in Washington DC will be converted into a 'top grade military complex' with drone and ammunition storage and sniper facilities, claiming the plan came at the 'strong request' of the US military.
source_title: Trump claims triumphal arch will serve as a ‘top grade military complex’ to store weapons

label: vowed to push ahead with reform agenda despite regional election setbacks
detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz's CDU suffered setbacks in two regional elections on September 20, 2026. In Berlin, Die Linke polled ahead of the CDU, and in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the AfD finished first. Merz called the CDU's performance a 'disaster' but vowed to push ahead with his reform agenda despite the results.
source_title: Germany: Merz vows to "push on despite setbacks"

label: admitted 'disaster' in state elections and vowed to press ahead with reforms
detail: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz described his CDU party's heavy losses in two regional elections as a 'disaster' but vowed to push ahead with reform plans. The CDU fell to 5.5% in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania and 20% in Berlin, while the far-right AfD made significant gains in both elections.
source_title: Germany’s Merz admits ‘disaster’ in state elections, vows to press ahead with reforms

label: fired over 1,000 drones at Russia in largest ever attack on Moscow
detail: Ukraine conducted a drone strike on Russia, firing over 1,000 drones in what was described as the largest ever attack on Moscow. The attack targeted various areas, mainly Moscow, and occurred during Russia's three-day Duma election vote.
source_title: Ukraine fires over 1,000 drones at Russia in "largest ever" attack on Moscow

label: closed French Language Centre in Tehran, alleging illegal acts and violation of diplomatic conventions
detail: Iranian authorities shut down the French Language Centre (CLF) in Tehran on Sunday, with the judiciary accusing it of conducting illegal acts that violated diplomatic conventions and abusing its status as a language training facility to identify and build networks among Iranian elite figures.
source_title: Iran closes French language centre in Tehran for ‘illegal acts’

label: Prime Minister Netanyahu said he intends to introduce legislation aimed at revoking the citizenship of people who defame IDF soldiers
detail: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced his intention to introduce legislation to revoke the citizenship of people who defame IDF soldiers, in response to the documentary NAZA which features anonymous military sources discussing the killing of civilians in Gaza.
source_title: 'NAZA' documentary about Gaza war sparks political storm in Israel

label: fired two short-range ballistic missiles into the East Sea
detail: North Korea fired two short-range ballistic missiles into the sea off its eastern coast on Sunday, with the first flying approximately 450 kilometres and the second flying more than 600 kilometres. South Korea's military detected and reported the launches, which came days after North Korea reaffirmed its nuclear-armed status and rejected a UN resolution calling for an end to its nuclear activities.
source_title: North Korea fires two ballistic missiles into the sea in latest weapons display

label: carried out major drone attack on Russian capital, targeting oil refinery
detail: Ukraine fired over 1,000 drones at Russia in what Moscow described as the 'largest ever' drone attack on the Russian capital, causing deaths in the Moscow region and inflicting damage on an oil refinery.
source_title: Ukraine hits Russia with major drone attack, targeting refinery

label: closed French Language Centre in Tehran, alleging illegal acts
detail: Iranian authorities shut down the French Language Centre (CLF) in Tehran on Sunday, alleging the French embassy-linked institute conducted illegal acts that violated diplomatic conventions.
